title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Reid Jenkins
comment: A very gripping story about the price of fame and fortune, didn't think I'd be into a book about Hollywood but Evelyn was such an intriguing character.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
comment: A whimsical book about the seemingly mundane activities of children who bloom by going outside (imagine). Really enjoyed the writing and the development of these characters as they discover what I guess we would call nowadays affirmation and optimism haha.

title: Six of Crows
author: Leigh Bardugo
comment: Ahh what a cliffhanger, it was very gripping and thrilling. Had unique worldbuilding and amazing characters, I loved them all. Can't wait to read the sequel :D.
